We made Dollastro 52 for players who love music and animated Doll cards. This single-player rhythm combat and card-collecting game pairs retro music with a cast of 52 Dolls.


Legendary Doll artwork from the full game.

Full-version development plans (the following features are in development and not yet available): 52 curated music tracks paired with 52 Doll cards; support for local MP3 folders and system audio, so you can play to the rhythm of your favorite music; and a chance to receive tradable Legendary Doll cards.

Attack, block and build combos

Tap to the music to attack. Consecutive on-beat hits build combos for more damage. Hold to block incoming strikes: a missed block lets your opponent recover health. Defeat each opponent before time runs out, and try again to improve your score.

Collect all 52 Dolls

Defeat Dolls in battle, then tap rapidly to capture them and reveal a holographic card. Find your favorites among the 52 characters of Season 1 and build your collection.

Choose a companion

Bring a captured Doll into your next battle. She attacks automatically and grows stronger as she fights: every ten companion attacks add one permanent level and one damage. Rarity changes her appearance; her attack level is shared across skins.

Welcome to Dominoir, a stylish noir casino where domino tiles become the tools of strategic mastery.

Build chains of tiles, trigger powerful upgrades, and manipulate the board to create massive scoring combos. Every run offers new strategies as you discover synergies between upgrades, tile modifiers, and clever placements.

Inspired by classic domino gameplay and modern roguelike deckbuilders, Dominoir turns simple tiles into a deep system of combo-building strategy.

Build insane scoring combos

Link domino tiles together to create scoring chains and multiply your score through clever placements.

The longer the chain, the bigger the multiplier.

But careful placement can unlock unexpected combo paths.

Build your collection of Schemes

Schemes are upgrades that change how your plays score. Find bonuses that suit your deck, combine effects, and discover combinations worth building an entire run around.

Between rounds, visit the shop to spend your Chips. Buy a promising upgrade or reroll in search of the missing piece. Your next purchase could change how you play.

Leave your Mark

Marks attach special effects to individual tiles. Turn a useful domino into a key part of your strategy, then pair it with Schemes that make the most of its strengths.

  • Golden tiles boost scores

  • Sticky tiles lock into place

  • Other modifiers open new strategies

Every run evolves in unexpected ways.

Play by the house’s rules

The casino has a few tricks of its own. Temporary House Rules change scoring, bonuses, and restrictions, while boss rounds put your strategy under pressure.

When the rules shift, can your build keep up?

Find your next favorite deck

Unlock domino decks with distinct bonuses and explore new ways to play. Track your best performances, fill out your collection, and return to the table with another combination in mind.

At the table

  • Strategic domino chains with limited plays and discards.

  • Schemes and tile-specific Marks to combine.

  • Shops between rounds to shape your build.

  • House Rules and boss rounds that demand adaptation.

  • Unlockable decks with different bonuses.

  • A noir casino atmosphere, with capybara company.

Take your seat. Make the next hand count.

This game requires a microphone to play.

You must stay silent in the morgue. Sound means death.

Welcome to *No Sound*. A voice-controlled psychological horror game where every sound you make could be your last.

You play as Shen Ting, a 21-year-old forensic intern, left alone in the morgue late at night to organize the body registration forms. The duty handbook says: "No sound is permitted after midnight." You hear knocking from inside the freezer. You decide to read the handbook first.

 The rules might be fake.

You see 4 rules, but some of them don't seem right. Blurred passages, altered wording—as if someone deliberately hid something. Which rules are real? Which were fabricated? You'll need to test them yourself.

 In the morgue, even your breath is your enemy.

Every movement, every hesitation could be detected by something. You'll find yourself holding your breath without realizing it—that's exactly what this game wants you to feel. Which sounds are safe and which will kill you? You'll have to find out.

 Find the truth, or be consumed by it.

The key is locked away. You're trapped. There are containers scattered around the room—maybe a clue lies inside one of them. Maybe somewhere else. Maybe you don't need a key at all.

You need to decide: which clues are real, and which are traps left behind on purpose? The rules in the handbook aren't necessarily reliable. When you discover the first rule is false—will you still trust the rest?

You can test, or you can stay silent. But every sound you make could bring you closer to the exit—or further away.

 A horror story you can experience firsthand.

*No Sound* is a new title set in the *Prison Chain* universe. If you enjoy solitary exploration, psychological terror, and narratives where nothing is what it seems—this game is for you.

Add to your Wishlist now and be among the first to uncover the truth.

Enemies keep coming and your soldiers fight on their own. You don't tell anyone where to go. You buy troops, spend gold and decide who is in your army. Your Hero stays behind the lines to shield, rally and heal them.



Humans, Undead, Orcs, Abyss, Dawnstar and Tideborn: six races, each with its own troops and trait. The more unit types you field from one race, the stronger its synergy. Push a synergy far enough and a giant Race Spirit joins the fight. Push further and it grows and gains a skill.
Every extra copy of a unit costs more: grow the army now, or save gold for the next wave? At the start and in the middle of each battle, pick one of three Orders. Every Order has a trade-off, and elites drop Order Chests for another pick.



Seven regions on the world map. Each one starts with a camp, then a stage down each of three roads, optional side stages, then the Boss. Your first clear drops a hammer: click it for a Talent Point. Later, send one race on an Expedition and it comes back with gear.



A Boss fight is 20 waves at the castle gate: The Headsman, Bone Dragon King, Orc Warchief, Abyss Warden, Archangel of Judgment, Leviathan of the Deep and Lord of the Mist. Lost a stage? The enemy who beat you remembers. Come back and it returns with a title.



Lose and you only drop the gold you carry. Gear, the Star Map and your Talents all stay, so the next run goes further. Loot gear from the start, salvage what you don't need and enhance your favourites. Light up the Star Map with XP for bonuses that last forever. Talents unlock the Hero, a bigger army and the Spellbook: turn enemies into sheep, or call in a crowd of goblins that drop gold. Clear the campaign to open Endless Mode.


An idle castle defense game. No fast fingers needed.
24 Steam achievements · Steam Cloud saves · 11 languages

A tiny dungeon at the bottom of your screen

Don't Rob My Dungeon is an idle dungeon defense game that lives in a thin strip along the bottom of your desktop while you work, study or watch videos. You are Mordo, a greedy little imp sitting on a mountain of gold. Heroes keep walking in to steal it. They will regret it.

Heroes come for your gold

Warriors, thieves, wizards and very brave peasants walk in through the door. Spikes, arrow walls, rolling boulders, explosive barrels, oil slicks and trapdoors are waiting for them. Every hero who falls drops gold. Thieves who reach the treasury grab a bag and run.

Build your dungeon

Dig new rooms, turn them into trap corridors or monster lairs, and upgrade everything. Skeletons, ghosts, bat swarms and a mimic that looks exactly like a treasure chest guard your halls. The more heroes you crush, the more infamous your dungeon gets, and the richer the heroes who come.

The Dark Hand

Feeling hands-on? Click a hero and a giant claw comes down from the ceiling.

Your Twitch chat raids your dungeon

Streamer mode: viewers type !join and walk into your dungeon as heroes with their own names and colors. Watch your chat get crushed, burned and dropped into pits. No login needed, just your channel name.

Made for your desktop

  • Keeps playing while you work, and counts what happened while the game was closed
  • Never steals focus or your mouse: clicks pass through to your apps
  • Under 1% CPU on a typical laptop
  • Pick the monitor, the size, and the top or bottom of the screen
  • Hides itself when a fullscreen game starts
  • Cozy lo-fi chiptune soundtrack, quiet by default

Every stage hides a rule. Step wrong, and it all collapses.

Don't Step Wrong 2 is a logic puzzle game built around deduction, experimentation, and strategy. Navigate grids of numbered blocks, symbols, words, and patterns — each governed by a secret rule you must uncover through observation and trial and error. Step on the wrong block, and the board collapses. A new puzzle is generated — same logic, new values. Try again.

But you don't have to rely on deduction alone.

As you progress, unlock skills that change how you approach each stage, and collect items that reveal clues, protect your progress, or give you a strategic edge. There's more than one way to solve a puzzle in Don't Step Wrong 2 — find yours.

Demo available June 2026 — Full game coming December 2026.

Features

  • Logic puzzles governed by hidden rules — mathematical, sequential, symbolic, and beyond

  • A board that collapses on every wrong step, generating a new puzzle with the same underlying logic

  • Skills and items that open alternative strategies beyond pure deduction

  • Multiple zones and environments, each with a distinct visual theme and atmosphere

  • Gradually increasing complexity — from rules shown upfront to rules you must deduce entirely on your own

  • Achievements that reward zone mastery, speedrunning, item collecting, and even learning the hard way

How to Play

Move across adjacent or diagonal blocks to reach the final tile. Each stage has a hidden rule determining which blocks are valid. Early stages reveal the rule — later ones leave it for you to figure out. Step wrong and the board collapses, reshuffling the values while keeping the same logic. Use skills and items to tilt the odds in your favor.
Welcome to Doodle Academy! Collect and fuse cards, combine heroes, races, and classes, and build your battle team. Experience a school fantasy story and ranked play.

Party Mode: VR and Web players join a room together. The VR player sees a canvas where web players draw on together and try to draw a given prompt together. VR doesn't see the prompt they could only see the live drawing being made and they have to try to sculpt that drawing with only 4 primitive shapes. 1-2 minute rounds

Sandbox Mode: Create sculptures with as much time as you want, save sculptures, build them later or reuse them for a bigger project.

  • 1 VR player + up to 7 phone players

  • Phones join at by room code or QR — nothing to install

  • 90 prompts, from "rocket" to "ferris wheel", each with its own clock: easy words get quick rounds, hard words get room to breathe

  • Add custom prompts to use instead of the default ones

  • Host sets the pace: Short, Regular, Long rounds

  • 4 primitive shapes: Sphere, Cone, Cube, Cylinder

When prophecy fails and the hero is absent, who will guide the dying world?

You are the chess master upon the ruins, wielding wisdom as a torch, leading the last of the strong on an expedition to uncover the truth.

​Wielding exclusive authority, they can switch combat stances in battle; each authority carries a unique team aura, rewriting the course of war through tactical combinations.

Break through mortal limits in the baptism of the apocalypse, freely ascend via multi-dimensional growth paths, and forge a top-tier combat force uniquely your own.

Traverse the shattered land, encounter heroes of all paths, and gradually piece together the hidden past of the apocalyptic end.

Challenge formidable foes in stages and cycles, gather strength, and advance toward the deepest reaches of the world to uncover the ultimate truth that could overturn everything.

In 2039, virus mixed with radiation wiped human civilization right off the map. Raging zombies are everywhere… Lead your crew through ruins, cook up a cure, and summon your mech when things go south to mow down hordes. You’re holding humanity’s last chance.

Sick of plinking zombies one by one? Flip into mech mode and go full rampage! Max armor + all cannons blazing — damage cranked all the way up. Swarmed by a solid wall of zombies? Blast your way out in one hit. Pure overpowered carnage.

Hordes drop random upgrade loot: damage, fire rate, mag size, health, regen, defense… Spray build, burst build, tanky survival build… Mix and match builds with your slick moves, and go all out.

Towns, highways, wastelands — every zone’s under siege. Different maps, different terrain, different zombie types. No one build works everywhere. No free wins.

Low-poly wasteland art style, full-on post-apocalyptic gloom. Paired with meaty gunfire and explosive effects — every hit lands hard. Lead your crew through ruins, scavenge samples, craft the cure. You’re the last hope this world’s got.

"Doomsday Anchor" is a document-style strategy management containment game. As the one holding the fate of the world in your hands, every decision must be made with caution!

What you can do:

- Do a completely normal... anomaly containment job (stamping to confirm execution is your duty)

- Chat with a mysterious white-haired assistant (she seems to know something)

- Manage human resources (don't let your employees become anomaly snacks)

- Distinguish truth from falsehood in piles of documents (fake anomalies? That's just a self-heating toilet)

- Balance four data values (Manpower, Chaos, Collapse, Distortion - sounds reassuring!)

- Contain anomalies in four directions: Physical, Mental, Contamination, and High-Dimensional

- Find a way out before doomsday comes (or... choosing to escape is also an option?)

Game Features:

- Multiple anomaly story chains, story branches, and endings (there's one for everyone)

- Thousands of anomalies to handle (from Carbonated Tyrant to Moonface, nothing is off-limits)

- Unique 2D document-style interface (like working in a real office)

- Rigorous written or black humor narrative style (dive into the mysterious world of anomalies and uncover the truth)

- Reincarnation mechanism (failure is not the end, you'll wake up again at the beginning of time)

- Card simulation for anomaly processing (place cards to complete their processing)

（This game is only available in Japanese. Some puzzles require an understanding of the Japanese language.）

You have stepped into a mysterious building.

In this building, the space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by placing Panels into the frame above the door. Memorize the Panels found in each room, arrange them to form words, and discover the way to escape.

Despite its simple rules, a series of puzzles will challenge your creativity and powers of insight.

Can you discover the “word” that will lead you to freedom?

  • Includes hints and answers.

  • Medium difficulty.

  • Features sound effects and background music.

  • A puzzle game focused on inspiration and logical thinking, where you memorize and arrange Panels to form words and discover the path to escape.

Estimated Play Time

90–120 minutes

Streaming & Video Content

You are welcome to stream, record, and upload gameplay videos of this game. Monetized videos and livestreams are also allowed.

Sound Effects

  • Sound Effect Lab

Cribbage with an engine under it

Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite. Underneath, it's the real game played by the book, and between hands you build something that bends it.

Powerups sit on your rail and change what the count is worth. One pays extra for every fifteen after the first. Another knocks the rival back down the board the first time they show a pair. When one of yours pays off big, its animal walks onto the table and acts it out. Fifteen Bell's fox rings a brass bell over your show. Drumline's heron beats a snare drum beside the run you just pegged.

Your pocket holds cards that break the rules once. Play the Four into the count and it walks the total back while the rival's peg slides down the board. The Mine takes the crib whoever dealt. Pegs bring their own rule to the whole run. The Spy sees what the rival threw to the crib, and the Hoarder carries extra pockets.

Every point moves your peg, hole by hole. Tiles on the board pay out gold, cards and powerups, but only to a peg that lands on them.

Never played? The Coach deals you in

You don't need to know cribbage to start. The Coach teaches it in a short warm-up at the parlor table. In the first hand the Coach points at each card and says why it counts. In the next the cards are yours. You throw, you peg, and you count your own hand by tapping the fifteens and pairs, with a hint whenever you're stuck. Then you're straight into your first real match.

Know the game already? Skip the warm-up and sit down.

Climb the cribbage mountain

The Long Tally is the climb. Twenty-one rivals stand between a back-room parlor and the top of the cribbage mountain, each with a painted face and a voice of their own. Captain Blue plays one suit and tells you which. He still wins. Brother Saunders brought a thermos to the Tundra and has never offered you any.

Higher up, the tables bring house rules of their own. Some put a chess clock on you, and near the top it's muggins, where any points you miss in your own count go to the rival. Some rungs let you mark a rank or a suit for good, and from then on those cards wear a tell on the backs of the rival's hand.

Losing never ends the climb. You pick how it stings when the campaign starts. Hold your spot and replay the same rival on a fresh board, or slide back a rung and win that trophy again.

Reach the summit and find out what's beyond. The Beyond runs on past the top, where every match is one long game of duplicate cribbage and a heat meter climbs as you play. When it boils over, the rival gets a free hole, and it boils faster the higher you go.

One deal, every player, every week

Each week brings a new challenge, and everyone plays the same deal. It's duplicate cribbage, so every hand comes round twice, once from each side of the table, and the luck of the cards cancels out. Your build and the rival's are fixed for the week, the rival plays at Expert, and the leaderboard ranks how far ahead of the rival you finished.

Every week has its own twist, and Skip and Skat bicker about it before you sit down.

Play a friend, or play it straight

Invite a friend through Steam or find a stranger with Quick Match. Ranked games move your Peg Rating and your place on the season leaderboard. If either game crashes mid-match, you can both come back to the same hand. And when your rival plays a good one, you can tip your hat.

Offline, the AI plays from Easy to Expert. Set the house rules before the deal. Play a best-of match or duplicate, turn muggins on, or try reverse, where the first peg home loses. Pure Cribbage switches every new system off, for the game the way your grandmother played it.

Company at the table

Skip and Skat are the skunks on the box. They host the weekly challenge, and when you play a card from your pocket they climb onto the table and do it themselves, shoving the rival's peg back or staking a claim to the crib you just took.

The Pedlar runs the shop partway round each board. He'll buy back what you've outgrown, and he's always heard something about your next rival.

The Coach stays with you after the warm-up and has a word about your throws.

Every hand, graded

When the match ends, the summary grades your game against the book. It shows how much your throws and your pegging gave up against the best you could have done, how kind the cuts were, and which hand cost you the most. Open the review and replay any hand, with your keep beside the book's and the better card beside the one you played.

Win by a mile and DOUBLE SKUNKED slams across the rival's portrait. That's where the game gets its name.



Fully voiced in English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

A note on AI-generated content

Double Skunk is made by one person. The character art, the short animated scenes, the music and sound, and the spoken voice lines were generated with AI tools and then selected, edited and assembled by hand. Nothing is generated while you play. The cribbage rules, the scoring engine and the balance are ours.

A village to rebuild. A continent to free.
Jake was a conscript who drowned pulling a stranger out of a frozen lake. He wakes in Levona, a ruined village losing a war against the Demon Lord. He can't go home, so he fights for the people who took him in.

You draft. Jake fights.
Combat is automatic. Between waves you choose one card from six, and every pick changes how the next fight plays out. Stack cards to strengthen them, match them to your weapon's affinity, and watch the build come together.

90 cards, nine affinities
Attack, Defense, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison, Wind, Healing and Toughness, from Common to Legendary. Burn, chill, shock and poison whole packs, or become too tough to kill.

12 weapons, three fighting styles
Swords, axes, daggers, spears, bows, and a crossbow, each rolled with its own affinity bonuses. Tell Jake to fight Normal, Evasive or Aggressive.

A story told in manga pages
16 handcrafted expeditions, five companions with their own endings, and a village that grows as you win.

New Game+
Seven tiers of harder runs with Legacy Blessings from your companions, plus 18 Steam achievements.

SPIN. SAIL. EXPLORE.

Lead a quirky adventuring crew across strange islands in a turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot-machine spin. Recruit new allies, discover powerful relics, and face unexpected encounters on every voyage.

  • Slot-machine Combat — Spin each turn to match elemental attacks from your party and earn wild bonuses.

  • Roguelite Strategy — Master skill cooldowns, discover powerful relic synergies, and adapt to random events.

  • 800+ Recruitable Crew — Build your party from a huge cast of quirky characters, encounter pirates and monsters, and chase an absurd treasure across a whimsical world.

    WISHLIST now using the green button above to be the first to challenge Dragon Era!

Crew members with matched elements attack enemies

Match the elements on the reels, and crew members with matching elements will strike your enemies.

Match 5 symbols on a winning line to trigger a powerful Area Attack (AoE)!

 

Activate skills to destroy powerful PIRATES!

Build up your skills and unleash powerful attacks to take down dangerous pirates and bosses.

Crew member skills can synergize with one another and with passive buffs from dozens of Relics.

 

Watch out and prepare for nasty boss skills

Bosses have devastating skills that can ruin your plans.

Watch their moves and plan ahead to avoid getting wiped out.

 

Assemble a party from 800+ crew members for your journey

Recruit from 800+ crew members and assemble the perfect party for your adventure.

Experiment with different crew member and Relic combinations to maximize synergy.

 

Steam Deck Support

The game has been tested to be playable with Steam Deck using the trackpad and Proton 9.0-4. If the game does not launch, please go to the properties screen (Gear Icon => Properties...) and choose Compatibility => "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" => choose "Proton 9.0-4".

A Hardcore Tactical SRPG Where Respect for Tradition Meets Bold New Ideas!

Inspired by the challenging strategy RPGs of the 1990s and 2000s,
this game is a full-fledged tactical SRPG built for players who love deep, demanding strategy.

Its defining features include the kind of satisfying difficulty rarely seen in today’s market,
a wealth of deep combat systems designed to support a wide variety of player strategies,
and a highly flexible progression system that lets you make the most of a cast of over 40 incredibly unique units.

But this is far more than a nostalgic tribute to the classics.
The game also introduces a wide range of distinctive original mechanics, creating a play experience that feels strangely familiar—yet somehow unlike anything you have played before.

The game balance has been carefully refined by developers who have played countless SRPGs over the years,
with extensive testing carried out by veteran players with more than 20 years of SRPG experience.

The deeper you understand its systems, the more rewarding the game becomes.

For dedicated SRPG fans, this is one you will not want to miss!

Especially Recommended For Players Who...

  • Have grown tired of conventional tactical RPGs

  • Are starting to find normal levels of difficulty a little too easy

  • Miss the brutal, brain-melting SRPGs of the late ’90s and early 2000s

  • Love taking their time, thinking things through, and experimenting with different strategies

Story / Synopsis

The setting: a full-blown medieval fantasy world.

Leia, princess of the absurdly enormous Republic—a perfectly ordinary land of swords and magic—has set out on a journey with you, the legendary strategist hailed as the greatest tactician on the continent for your exploits in the War of the Seven Stars seventeen years ago.

Her goal is to find her beloved only daughter, Cynthia, whom she accidentally left behind at a horribly overpriced amusement park when she was little, resulting in their tragic separation.

Unfortunately, during a stop in the Camellia Empire, Leia overhears details of a sinister imperial plot.

Naturally, this results in her being transformed into an exquisitely crafted doll by a corrupt dollmaker.

As for you?

Your memories are stolen, you are beaten senseless, bound up like a rug, and thrown into the ocean.

After narrowly escaping death, you eventually wash ashore on Sicily Island, in the eastern reaches of the continent.

Sicily is ruled by a mysterious mafia organization known as the Nostra Family.

In the island’s port town of Baymarine, Leia’s daughter Cynthia just happens to be running an underground pizzeria called Pizzeria Cynthia, which also doubles as a shady odd-jobs service—or “Trouble Busters”—under one of the Family’s subordinate organizations.

By an incredible stroke of convenience, you are rescued by the very same pizzeria.

While helping Cynthia with her jobs as she pursues her burning ambition to rise through the underworld and become one of the Family’s top executives, you begin searching for clues to recover your lost memories.

Along the way, you learn of the Basques, a group of illegal immigrants driven from their homeland whose presence has become a growing issue across the continent.

One day, while distributing food to the residents of Baymarine, Cynthia and you encounter Nadja, the supreme leader of the Basque faith.

As you become entangled with him and those pursuing him, you uncover a cold war brewing between nations over the migrant crisis—and the sinister ambitions of the Camellia Empire lurking behind it all.

Before long, Cynthia and you find yourselves swept into a conflict that will engulf the entire continent───

GAME OVERVIEW

Dragons Invasion is a 2D horizontal shooter, playable solo or in local co-op. Master the Dash and Color Swap — slay dragons or absorb their shots to charge your power gauge. Match their color. Unleash your power. Destroy them all. Be tough. Be skilled. Save the land.

ARCADE SPIRIT

Grab a friend. Take on a sky full of dragons. Share the glory. 2-player local co-op available at launch.

STORY

The kingdom is under attack by dragons. It's up to you to set it free! Choose one of four unlikely heroes and fight your way across the entire kingdom — from the devastated city to the haunted mines, through mysterious swamps and all the way to the castle.

HERO — THE ROOSTER KNIGHT

His blade never stops. Unleash sword volleys that evolve from a single precise strike into a devastating four-blade cross barrage.

ARROWEN — THE ARROW BREATHER

Riding her trusty owl, Arrowen strikes with deadly precision. Fire straight shots, diagonal spreads, and homing arrows. At full power, she unleashes a gigantic arrow that stretches across the entire screen.

GAMEPLAY - 3 magical colors, red, blue, green. Match the enemy color to kill it.

  • Swap Colors → autoshoot destroys enemies

  • Power Gauge (5 levels): your color halo absorbs matching fire → fills your gauge  → boosts your shots. Get hit → gauge and powers drop

  • Dash: multidirectional agility skill

  • Piercing Attack: hits in front of you during a dash (hits all enemies, even colorless)

  • Roll: invincible move ending with a finishing strike (hits all enemies, even colorless)

  • Invocation: A priest gives you a scroll that lets you summon a powerful warrior spirit for a devastating attack.

  • Rewards: Defeat a boss, pick one of three items to power up your current run: faster movement, quicker attacks, raw power, and more.

The Road Doesn't Care If You Make It

Dravora is a narrative roguelite about three people on the roads of a politically fractured, early medieval continent. There are no combat screens, no stat sheets, no skill trees. Every interaction is a choice made in words — and every choice has consequences that follow you down the road.

Your companions are people, not party members. They joined because your road overlaps with theirs. They have their own values, their own limits, their own reasons for traveling. Push them past those limits and it costs you. Protect what they care about and they'll follow you into places they shouldn't.

Three Origins on One Road

The Broken Crown. At Vaerhold, a fallen mercenary takes a contract to walk a lady and her young apprentice east. The road runs through Tarvenor, Cennovar and the Bound Tides. Food, coin and supplies run down, and word on the road is that somebody is worth money to somebody.

The Burned Cord. Seren of Bryenvar is an oath-singer's apprentice, sent out to sing at the moots of the west. There she meets the Burned Cord: westerners who say the settlement that ended the old order was kept to the letter and broken in spirit. Caelen, a ford-keeper's son who says what nobody else will, walks the circuit with her. What she hears on the road, she will have to answer for at home.

The Small Refusal. Emrec is the youngest of three brothers in the fen village of Mirefen. His brothers have work for him, the kind that pays and isn't asked about. He has a girl from the landing he means to marry, and nothing to marry her on. A short, hard story about one family and a few days of choices.

Who You Are Is What You Choose

There is no character creation screen. No alignment wheel. No morality meter.

Your character's identity emerges from what you do when the choices are hard and the answers aren't clear. Feed the starving refugees or save the food for your own people. Tell your party the truth about how bad things are or lie to keep morale alive. Face the bandits or find another way around.

Every decision quietly reveals who you were all along — and the world responds to who it sees. Your companions notice. The people you meet notice. By the end, you'll notice too.

Features

  • Three origins at launch — each with its own characters, road and story through the same living world. Different starting points, different stakes, different stories.
  • Choices that cascade — a decision at the river crossing echoes three days later when a consequence you didn't expect arrives. The game remembers what you did and builds on it.
  • Companions with their own agendas — they'll challenge your choices, reveal themselves over campfire conversations, and remember what you did.
  • An identity system that watches — no visible stats. Your personality emerges from accumulated choices and manifests through how the world treats you, what options you see, and what your companions say about you when they think you're not listening.
  • Survival through scarcity — food, coin, and supplies. Three numbers. The math is simple. The choices the math forces on you are not. Hunt, forage or stand watch at camp, trade at market, and go hungry when you can't.
  • Twelve endings and deep replayability — four in the Broken Crown, five in the Burned Cord, three in the Small Refusal. Different choices reveal different people, and every run ends with a story worth telling.
  • No combat minigames — when violence happens, it's a choice you make and a consequence you live with, not a screen you grind through.
  • Every road ends in a story — at the end of every journey your ending plays out and the road you took is written down. Who joined. Who left. Who didn't make it. Who you became.

Built By One Person

Dravora is developed by a solo developer using AI-assisted tools for art, code, and narrative drafting. No human artists, writers, or developers were displaced — without these tools, this game would not exist. Every creative decision, every piece of worldbuilding, every design choice is human-made. The tools helped build what one person couldn't build alone.

🏠 Turn a blank, empty house into the home of your dreams - with a single brush.

In Draw My Home you need no art training and no trip to a furniture store. Beds, sofas, fridges, lamps, teddy bears, cats and dogs... every piece of furniture, appliance, toy, and animal is drawn by your own hand, stroke by stroke. Each one is one of a kind, carrying your personal touch.

· Draw furniture, appliances, toys, and animals yourself

· Place what you drew into the empty house and build kitchens, bedrooms, studies

· A ~7-second "magic brush" style synchronized drawing replay

· 15 rooms waiting to be decorated

· Decorating unlocks family pets that live in your home

· Fresh, cute pixel-art style

· Completely free - just open and start drawing

✨ Magic-brush drawing - the game's signature feature

This is the moment in Draw My Home that will take your breath away.

When you arrange all the items you want to decorate with inside the empty house and press start, a miracle happens: every piece of furniture, appliance, toy, and pet you drew begins "drawing itself" on the wall at the same time - from the first blank line to fully colored and finished, in about 7 seconds the whole room comes alive.

Like the legendary magic brush that brings pictures to life: you only decide the layout, and the brush does the rest. In that moment you are not a decorator - you are a creator.

You can replay this "everything grows" drawing process anytime, watching your home rise from a bare wall into a warm, lived-in space. This magic belongs to Draw My Home alone.

🎨 15 rooms - build your whole world

Kitchen, bedroom, study, living room, bathroom, kids' room... 15 rooms in all await your touch. Start from the first line and slowly fill the empty house. Every room takes the shape you drew yourself - no repeated showroom templates, only your home.

🌟 Decorating unlocks family pets

Finish decorating a room and you unlock a new member - a cat, a dog, a rabbit... Keep them in the rooms you built and watch them play among the furniture you drew. A home is only complete with company.

🏡 Cute pixel art

Every room is rendered in a fresh, bright, healing pixel-art style. Clean lines, gentle colors - each house feels like a quiet, tender nursery rhyme.

🐱 Completely free

Draw My Home is a completely free game. No barriers: open it and draw, draw and decorate. Your dream home costs not a single coin.

💖 Start now - draw your home.

YOU DO NOT FIGHT. YOU PREPARE.

Dreadgence is a deterministic horror autobattler set inside the wounds of a dead god.

Bind extinct monsters as Pacts. Equip them with Rites and Relics. Prepare a three-monster composition capable of surviving what waits inside each Wound. Then deploy.

Your monsters fight automatically. You win by preparing the right answer, not by issuing commands during combat.

SEND YOUR PACTS INTO THE WOUNDS.

Three Pacts enter. The Wound answers.

Your monsters choose targets, move, attack, unleash abilities, and fight without your intervention. Hostile creatures obey their own behaviors.

Face swarms of enemies, dangerous compositions, and increasingly powerful bosses across haunting environments.

You choose what enters the battlefield. Then you watch what survives.

CHANGE THE RELIC. CHANGE THE FATE.

Before battle, read the Wound's exact forecast. Will your Pacts survive or will the encounter destroy them?

The outcome isn't left to chance. The same preparation against the same Reading produces the same result.

Sometimes one Relic is the difference between failure and victory. Study the forecast, change your composition, and rewrite what happens next.

A failed battle is evidence. Learn from it.

BIND WHAT SHOULD HAVE STAYED DEAD.

The monsters you defeat can become the monsters you command.

  • Pacts: Bind extinct creatures into your growing roster. Each brings its own identity, strengths, and behavior.

  • Rites: Equip abilities that shape how your monsters fight and what roles they perform.

  • Relics: Arm your Pacts with powerful items, then evolve those items to awaken new effects.

Every new acquisition creates another possibility. Build specialized teams, experiment with combinations, and watch your collection grow.

CONQUER. AUTOMATE. DEEPEN.

Master a Reading, then automate the work you've already solved.

Build stronger Pacts, collect new Rites and Relics, evolve your equipment, and prepare for more dangerous encounters. Offline progression lets your victories continue working while you're away.

Your next breakthrough should come from a better strategy.

THE ATLAS REMEMBERS EVERYTHING.

Every Wound is a chapter in the autopsy of a dead god. Every extinct creature is another name written into the record.

You are the Blank Leaf: a page torn from the Atlas, given a body, and erased from its memory.

The Wounds remember everyone who died inside them.

They do not remember you.

Read the blood. Close the Wound.

Hold Back the Dark

Your lantern keeps the dark at bay. Step beyond its glow for scrap, build an arsenal of up to six weapons, and survive an arena that grows more dangerous as Dread rises.

Build a Monstrous Arsenal

Equip up to six weapons and combine their strengths into a build that can survive the horde. Orbiting blades, traps, projectiles, close-range tools, and cursed effects create wildly different ways to fight.

The Arena Remembers

High Dread opens ritual scars in the arena. These wounds persist between waves and make the battlefield harder to cross. Spend scrap to seal dangerous scars, or keep it for weapons and relics in the Black Market.

Make Every Wave Count

Collect scrap, visit the Black Market, combine weapons, buy relics, and prepare for escalating horrors. Survive all 15 waves and kill the final boss, or let the dark claim another run.

Current Early Access Scope

  • 18 survivors with distinct starting identities

  • 36 weapons across multiple attack styles

  • 174 relics for build-defining combinations

  • 11 escalating Curse levels

  • A 15-wave run with bosses and persistent ritual scars

  • Keyboard, mouse, and controller play

Dreadmark is a top-down action RPG set over one long night. A parish raised its own dead to fight a plague, and the dead stayed. You fight your way from a refugee camp to the cathedral where their master waits, pick up what they drop, and keep rebuilding your character until it can survive the next fight. It is hard on purpose.

Fights you can read

Heavy hitters and bosses wind up before they strike, and the ground shows where the blow will land. Rangers show their aim as a line that follows you until they let go. Step out of it or roll through it. A Templar can also take it on the shield and punish the recovery. When you get hit, it should be because you misread the fight.

Magic and rare monsters roll affixes of their own, so a rare pack can hit faster, carry more life or bring an aura. On hardcore a death is permanent, and one bad read against the big ones can end a character.

Classes, runes and loot

The Templar wins fights by standing in them. Landing hits and blocking them builds Wrath, which he spends on cleaves, smites and thrown censers. The Witch keeps her distance and lets poison and rot spread from body to body, then bursts everything she has infected at once. Each has three skill trees, every skill takes a rune that changes what it does, and more classes join after launch.

Items roll their affixes from where they dropped, so the deeper you go the better they get. Some cast a skill when you are struck, others add poison to every hit. Orbs reroll and upgrade what you find, and the Dread Sigil can push an item past anything it could roll on its own, or ruin it.

A new road with every map

Beat the Dark Lord and he leaves a Dread Map behind. Spend orbs on it and it picks up modifiers. Some make packs bigger, some make monsters tougher or their blows heavier, and the spoils grow with every one.

Open the map at the stone frame in camp and the game lays out a stretch of road for it from pieces we built, so every map is ground you have not walked. Die inside and walk back in, and the same road is waiting.

Alone on the road, together on the ladder

Today you play alone, inside a world that is shared. Live ladders rank Self-Found and Account-Found characters on boards of their own, and a run only shows up with proof that it was really played. The Reckoning times a new Self-Found character's run to the Dark Lord.

Fallen hardcore characters stay on the board as ghosts you can inspect, gear and all. When someone is the first to reach a level or to bring down the Dark Lord, the Herald names them in chat.

Bug reports and suggestions go to the Dreadmark Discord, where the people making the game read them, and the popular ideas usually ship within days.

Planned for the Early Access launch

Early Access is planned for Q2 2027. For that launch we plan a bigger endgame, a longer campaign deeper into the parish and procedural dungeons. Off the main road we want people to talk to, side areas, side missions and pieces of the parish's story to find, and new kinds of monsters beside the undead.

We also plan an Auction House for trading what you find, and a season that starts at launch with fresh ladders. Co-op with friends and PvP against other players are planned for version 1.0. Plans can change, and the Discord and the devlog will say so when one does.

DREAM GLITCHER

You are not the hero.

In Dream Glitcher, a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click mystery, you are a scientist tasked with entering the

consciousness of Luna — an advanced android experiencing unexplained emotional breakdowns.

Inside her positronic mind, you become an artificial observer, searching fragmented memories and experiences for the

source of her apparent instability.

But Luna is not malfunctioning.

She is feeling.

EXPLORE A WORLD SHAPED BY MEMORY

Journey through a vibrant retro-futuristic world where familiar places give way to surreal landscapes shaped by Luna's

emotions and perception of reality.

Investigate environments, interact with characters and objects, solve puzzles, and piece together fragmented memories.

Reconstruct Luna's relationships, fears, desires, and the events that brought her here.

YOUR CHOICES LEAVE TRACES

Conversations reveal different perspectives, while branching dialogue and emotionally driven decisions shape the

investigation.

As you uncover the truth, Luna's mental and physical condition evolves through a dynamic health indicator that reflects the

consequences of your choices and discoveries.

Every answer brings you closer to understanding Luna. But not necessarily closer to understanding yourself.

DESCEND INTO THE SUBCONSCIOUS

Using Assisted Emotional Alignment (AEA), a psychoanalytic system, venture deeper into Luna's subconscious, where

suppressed memories and symbolic manifestations conceal the truths she struggles to accept.

What begins as a clinical investigation gradually becomes something far more personal.

WHAT MAKES US HUMAN?

Beneath its colourful, hand-drawn world lies a psychological sci-fi mystery about identity, consciousness, empathy, and the

blurred boundary between human emotion and artificial intelligence.

As the investigation unfolds, the distinction between observer and participant becomes increasingly uncertain.

If Luna is becoming human… then what exactly are you?

KEY FEATURES

  • Hand-drawn 2D cyberpunk world — Explore atmospheric retro-futuristic locations and surreal environments.

  • Narrative-driven point-and-click gameplay — Investigate scenes, interact with objects, and solve puzzles.

  • Interactive graphic-novel storytelling — Reconstruct Luna's past through conversations, discoveries, and cinematic

narrative sequences.

  • Branching dialogue and meaningful choices — Make emotionally driven decisions with consequences for the

unfolding investigation.

  • Assisted Emotional Alignment (AEA) — Explore Luna's subconscious and uncover suppressed memories through

the game's psychoanalytic system.

  • Dynamic health indicator — Observe changes in Luna's mental and physical condition as your decisions and

discoveries affect her.

  • Expansive cyberpunk world — Encounter more than 100 characters and locations.

  • English voice acting — Experience the story with English voices.

Every night, someone has to stand between the child and the dark

Dreamfend is a pixel-art roguelite survivor about a child's favorite toy guarding their sleep. The child won't wake until morning. Whatever comes for them tonight, you're the one who meets it.

Key features

  • 40-minute runs, waves growing stronger every minute

  • 25 weapons, up to 6 per build

  • 15 passive abilities, up to 3 per build

  • 4 bosses, each with their own AoE attacks

  • Rage builds in the dark: more damage and crit, but it turns on you when it overflows

  • Free movement across the map, hunting for upgrades

  • Notes scattered on the map reveal the child's story

  • Permanent upgrades between runs

One against the swarm

Monsters close in from every side, and every minute brings more. You start fighting them off with a single weapon — by the end of the night, a whole arsenal orbits you.

Choose your weapons

Level up your toy and build a loadout of 6 weapons — there are 25 in all, and every one plays differently. Add 3 passive abilities out of 15, stack them, push them further, and outgrow any nightmare.

Grow stronger, but don't lose yourself

Rage gathers in the dark. The more of it you carry, the faster you tear through the swarm — and the closer you come to no longer being yourself. Find the child among the horde to cool down, or push all the way and take the risk.

Uncover the story

The child's memories surface in the dark. Learn how it all started, how it ended, and who you are in this story.

The night doesn't last forever

To reach the nightmare itself, you'll have to weaken it — kill the reflections it hides its power in. Each one fights its own way, and none of them forgive mistakes. Take too long and the nightmare grows past you, and that meeting is one you won't survive. Find them all.

Find forgotten toys

Roaming the map and killing monsters turns up other toys. Track them down and try the unique attacks each forgotten one brings.

A toy never forgets

Hunt for treasure and upgrade the weapons you fell in love with between runs. Unlock new ones and come back the next night stronger than before.

The inspiration for the gameplay comes from the "The Room" series and various old-fashioned Point-and-Click puzzle games.

————————————————————————————————

Gameplay:

Use the mouse to click, double-click, and drag objects in the scene to move and rotate the camera, pick up and use items, and solve puzzles.

Game objective:

In the cozy courtyard setting, solve the puzzle mechanisms until you obtain the diary fragments of each chapter, and piece together the complete story from the memories.

Adam wakes in an impossible frozen world. He meets Amelia, a young girl trapped in the same nightmare. Connected by a shared subconscious, they must navigate decaying dreamscapes together in search of a way out.

Winter Dreamscape

A frozen reality inspired by the nostalgia of CCD cameras and post-Soviet winter landscapes. Silent, snow-covered architecture and liminal spaces blur the line between memory and dream.

Instinct and Adrenaline

A first-person psychological horror experience built around sudden encounters, instinct, and adrenaline. Hostile entities and distorted environments challenge your perception, forcing you to react before fear takes over.

Tools of the Dream

Essential tools for survival and solving puzzles. Both the blinding flash and the purple glasses are needed to fight hostile entities, interact with the environment, and uncover hidden clues. Timing and restraint are critical—using them blindly won't work.

Puzzles and Notes

Progression is tied to observation and unraveling the past. Scattered handwritten notes, cryptic ciphers, and layered environmental puzzles are woven directly into the world, requiring players to piece together clues to unlock pathways and survive the nightmare.

You make the hero. Then you let go.

Drift Quest is a dark fantasy RPG that plays itself. Pick a race and a class, roll your stats and press Start Quest. From then on your hero carries on alone, one action every five seconds: slaying a wraith, digging up bloodroot, exploring an old library, selling a sack of rat bones to a merchant who never asks where they came from.

It's an idle game in the spirit of Progress Quest: a text RPG that sits in a corner of your screen while you work, study or play something else, and that you check on whenever you feel like it. There's nothing to click and no timer to babysit.

Free demo: a little over two hours of play, and your hero carries over to the full game.

Build your hero

Choose one of 9 races (Human, Elf, Orc, Dwarf, Reptilian, Gnome, Undead, Goblin or Troll) and one of 7 classes, from Archer to Warlock. Race and class are there for flavor. The numbers that matter are Strength, which decides how much loot your hero can carry before heading to the merchant, and Wisdom, which decides how many spells they can learn. Reroll the six stats as often as you like. Your hero goes by your Steam name.

Every five seconds, something happens

After a short prologue in a castle town, the story runs in chapters of 15 quests, and every quest takes 15 actions. There are 300 different actions, and each one leaves its own thing in the bag: rat bones, venison, an ancient tome, a quartz gem, chanterelles, a health potion. Quests go by names like "The bleeding cathedral" and "The hollow god rises". The chapters don't run out.

The current action plays out on its own line with a progress bar, while the plot and quest lists fill in beside it.

The merchant never closes

When the bag is full, your hero walks to the merchant without being told, sells everything one piece at a time and spends a few coins on new gear. There are 16 slots to fill, two rings included, and nothing stops your hero from carrying a melee weapon, a shield, a bow and a wand at the same time. Each new piece gets one of 800 names, like Obsidian Fable or Runic Fury, and rolls its stats against your level. Sometimes it's an upgrade. Sometimes the merchant wins.

Levels and 177 spells

Every level, each of the six stats can go up a little. With enough Wisdom, your hero also learns a new spell, picked at random from 177: Frost Bolt, Glacial Spike, Winter Breath and plenty more. Spells are collected, not cast, so the spell book just keeps growing. Hover over an item or a spell to read its name, or over a piece of gear to check its stats.

Made for the corner of your screen

  • A borderless window you can drag anywhere, in 16:9 sizes from 1280×720 up to the largest that fits your monitor, or fullscreen with F11
  • Keeps playing when you click away or minimize it, and slows itself down in the background so it stays light on your PC
  • Your hero only travels while the game is open. Close it and they wait for you
  • Remembers its size and position, mutes the music with M and can mute itself in the background
  • Playable with the mouse alone

Also in Drift Quest

  • Eight achievement tracks in the game, plus Steam achievements
  • A global Top 10 for time played
  • 50 music tracks, shuffled
  • 30 interface languages
  • Steam Cloud saves
  • One purchase, with no microtransactions and no ads

Drift Quest is made by one person at NecoPlanet. If a quiet RPG in the corner of your screen sounds good, add it to your wishlist and Steam will let you know when it launches.

Step into high-speed, full-contact aerial competition where precision flying and teamwork decide every match. Whether you're threading a perfect scoring run as the Striker or slamming opponents out of the sky as a Defender, every second is pure adrenaline.

Drone Soccer is the premiere simulation of the world’s fastest-growing aerial sport. For the uninitiated, the real-world sport is a fast-paced blend of traditional soccer strategy and aggressive, full-contact drone piloting. We've translated that exact experience into the digital arena.

What is Drone Soccer?

  • The Drones: You aren't flying fragile camera drones. Every quadcopter is encased in a durable, spherical cage. This means you can—and will—smash into walls, the floor, and other players at full speed without dropping out of the sky.

  • The Arena: Matches take place inside a giant netted cage. Suspended in the air at either end of the arena are two large, circular goal hoops.

  • The Rules: Two teams of five face off simultaneously. However, out of the five drones on a team, only one is designated as the Striker.

  • The Objective: The Striker is the only player capable of scoring points by flying through the opposing team's goal hoop. The other four players act as Defenders. Their job is to act as aerial battering rams—blocking the enemy Striker from scoring, protecting their own goal, and smashing a clear flight path for their Striker to attack.

    5v5 Online Multiplayer

    Dive into fast-paced 5v5 matchups that demand sharp reflexes and solid teamwork. With a fully lobby-based system, you dictate how and who you play. Spin up a private, friends-only lobby to practice strategies with your squad, or browse public lobbies to join teams from across the globe.

    Practice Modes

    New to flying drones or looking to sharpen your edge? Jump into dedicated practice modes to refine your mechanics, experiment with settings, and master advanced maneuvers before heading into competitive play.

    Realistic Flight Physics

    This isn’t arcade flying. Experience authentic drone handling modeled after real drone soccer ball flight. Fine-tune your controls with fully customizable rate profiles to match your flying style—whether you're a precision pilot or an aggressive brawler.

In DropCell, clearing a line is only the start of the move.

When a line clears, the blocks above it fall into the gaps. If they land in new lines, those clear too, and the blocks above them fall again.

One well-placed piece can set off a chain that runs all the way down the board, and each link scores more than the one before. The game is about building those chains and reading the board to set them up.

HOW IT PLAYS

  • Clear lines to start cascades. Every clear drops the board above it, and new lines clear on their own without another move.

  • Score comes from the cells you clear, multiplied by chain length, combos, and hard drops. The longer the chain, the higher the score.

  • Carve gaps on purpose so one piece collapses several lines at once. The further you plan ahead, the bigger the chain.

  • Plan your placements with a three-piece preview, a hold slot, a landing shadow, and a lock delay that gives you time to adjust.

  • React according to block shapes: 3-cell or 5-cell.

  • Blocks come in two flavors: glued and segmented. Glued ones are stationary after a clear, while segmented ones have their cells falling - enabling more combos.

  • Beware of rising rows: more difficult levels will raise rows from time to time, making the pressure go up, but allowing for more scoring as well.

50 levels, five in each realm, each with its own score target, speed.

18 achievements covering skill, a run through every realm, and hidden ones to find.

Drums & Steel is a formation-based real-time strategy game where you command massed 18th-century style armies in standalone skirmishes and campaigns. Master your forces, exploit the terrain, and understand the limits of both your troops and the enemy. Break their will to fight before they break yours.

Command Your Army

  • Supports the uploading of your own units, artwork, and even whole factions

You are a contract field technician for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. Night shift, an offshore platform. Your job is to fix every breakdown as quickly and as cheaply as possible and get back before the helicopter leaves.

Wrap burst pipes with DuckTape-9000, weld the cracked bracket at the top of the crane, put out fires, replace the power box battery and recover the server data for HQ. The tasks change every shift. The budget does not.

You are not alone on the platform. Something in the dark can hear you, especially when you are carrying a hissing fuel can. Falling off the crane is not considered a workplace accident. It is considered a personal choice.

In 1-5 player co-op shifts, revive knocked-out teammates with the defibrillator, or drag them to the helicopter if that fails. You can play solo, but nobody will be there to drag you. When the tasks are done, the helicopter lands and the pilot waits for no one. At the end of the shift, the company files its report: tasks completed, time spent and personnel lost.

Hit the beat. Wreck the board.

Duckstep is a rhythm game about a duck, his very strange friends, and a screen full of gems that need smashing. Gems fall down the lanes, you hit them on the beat, and every clean hit sets something off: your character's power, the skills you drafted, the items circling your head. The score in the corner climbs from thousands to millions to numbers that need new letters.

The catch: none of it runs on a timer. Every power, skill and item fires on YOUR press. Play on the beat and the whole screen plays with you. Lose the beat and it all goes quiet.

The loop

  • Hit: Perfects in a row stack a streak multiplier. A Good holds it, a miss resets it.
  • Draft: clean hits fill a meter. Fill it and the game pauses to deal you a hand of skills. Thirty skills, ten slots, and three copies of one evolves it.
  • Duck Step: your streak charges the Duckstep meter. Fire it and your stepper turns into a pinball, banks everything you're holding, and shields your streak while it bounces.
  • Jackpot: every Duck Step marks a Jackpot note. Hit it yourself for a rush where every press pays triple.
  • Ultimate: reach a 400 combo and pick one of three Ultimates that rewrites the rest of your run.
Catch multiplier chips and let them ride, grab a lucky Fever ball, and play your HP back up with clean hits. Every run ends with a rank from S to C, judged only on your own presses.

Twenty steppers, twenty powers

Everyone plays the same songs. Nobody plays them the same way. Each of the twenty characters has a signature power that switches on at a 25 combo and grows at 100, 200 and 300, from a frog with a laser tongue to a duck with a ring of fire. Find the one that fits your hands, or unlock them all and see what breaks.

Twenty levels, twenty weird ideas

Every level has its own song, its own hand-made chart mapped to the song's real beats, and its own twist: bomb gems you should NOT press, lights that die the longer you last, a twin of your character that shows up to play your other hand, a DJ who flips the lanes mid-song. Easy, Medium and Hard are separate charts, four levels are endless, and HYPER and RAW are there when you want to suffer properly.

Earn everything. Buy nothing.

Every run pays out. Gems and Crowns unlock new characters, new skills for the draft and new Ultimates for the 400-combo pick, and the only way to get them is to play. Clearing a level opens the next, endless levels open theirs when you survive long enough, and nearly 90 quests keep handing you something new to chase. Some characters don't wait in the shop at all: play the right way on the right level and they come find you.

No premium currency, no energy bar, nothing to buy your way past.

Bring a friend (or a bot with an attitude)

VS puts two full cabinets side by side. Clean presses charge your counter, and when you send it, your combo becomes your opponent's problem. Nobody around? Take on the AI: Chill, Even or Sharp.

Play it your way

  • Keyboard, controller or dance mat, with remappable lanes.
  • A quick tap test tunes the timing to your setup.
  • Grey Gems and Reduced Flash for easier reading.
  • Played the demo? Your progress comes with you.

The Ultimate TV Show Feeling at Home!

Step up to the podium and face the challenge! In this purely competitive 1v1 show game, it’s not about luck—it’s about your skills. Inspired by the great primetime TV duels, a thrilling battle of wits awaits you, where every single round counts!

Decide for yourself how epic your duel should be: choose between a quick 6-round show, an intense 12-round match, or the full 15-round marathon experience. The point values increase with every round—meaning maximum suspense until the very last game!

What Awaits You:

  • 30 Minigames: A diverse mix that will challenge you every single second. No two rounds are ever the same!

  • Versatile Categories:

    • Knowledge: Show off what you’ve got in the brains department.

    • Guessing: Who can get closest to the actual truth?

    • Speed: Who will trigger the buzzer first?

    • Memory: Keep your focus when things get chaotic.

    • Logic: Spot the patterns faster than your opponent.

  • Flexible Show Mode: Adjust the length of the show (6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds) to match your time and mood.

  • Pure Podium Thrills: Every game demands total concentration. One wrong buzz could cost you the entire victory!

Challenge your friends and find out once and for all who is the true champion of the podium!

Dugout Dice is a baseball roguelite where the bat and the ball are replaced with five dice.

Roll poker hands to put runs on the board to increase your multiplier and to gain cash. Spend cash between innings on Superfan Boosts, Die Mods, and Suite Tickets that bend the game in your favor.

Dugout Dice blends the tension of baseball with the risk/reward mechanics of a roguelike deckbuilder.

Every hit is decided by the hand you build and every run is different.

Three of a Kind: Single

Full House: Double

Straight: Triple

Four of a Kind: Home Run

Five of a Kind: Grand Slam

Anything less is an out. Three outs in one inning and the game is over.

BUILD YOUR ROSTER & BREAK THE GAME

  • Suite Vouchers: High-value upgrades that expand crew slots, discount shop items, and juice base hit values.

  • Die Mods: Bolt powers onto individual dice that trigger whenever they land.

  • Over 100 Superfan Boosts and more to come: Assemble a crew of passive perks that trigger on every swing to build a massive scoring engine.

  • Signings: Draft free agents into your batting order to upgrade your baseline rolling power.

KEY FEATURES

Season Long Strategy - Play a full season and face team unique closers and starting pitchers. Do you go for quick innings or try to drive the starting pitcher out early?

  • Unlockables: Unlock new legendary Superfans, die mods, stadiums, early access to a cheat menu and more

  • Six Ballparks, Escalating Difficulty: Climb the ladder from the Tulsa Fractures in Rookie ball to the Cooperstown All-Stars in the Hall of Fame.

  • Population Limit Victory: Bank 8,125,000,000 Fans in a single inning, one for every person on Earth, to break the game

Many more updates to come!

EMBARK ON A JOURNEY ACROSS EUROPE

Dumi’s Adventure: Across Europe is a first-person narrative adventure where every kilometer brings you closer to the truth.

Pass through towns and cities, cross regions in different countries, explore hidden places, and follow the clues left behind by your grandfather’s past.

What begins as a road trip soon pulls you into a story far more dangerous than you ever imagined.

KEEP YOUR CAR RUNNING

Your car is much more than just a means of transportation.

Repair it, replace parts, check its fluids, refuel, and prepare it for the next stretch of the journey. A breakdown in the middle of the road can quickly turn a peaceful drive into a serious problem.

EXPLORE AND DISCOVER

Leave the main road behind and venture into towns, forests, mines, facilities, ports, and other locations shaped by a story that slowly begins to connect.

Talk to characters, investigate your surroundings, and uncover clues about organizations, experiments, and secrets that have remained hidden for years.

SURVIVE WHAT YOU FIND

Not every place you visit will be empty.

Face wild animals, altered creatures, infected enemies, and armed groups using melee weapons and firearms.

Exploration may give you answers. It may also get you into trouble.

UNCOVER YOUR GRANDFATHER’S PAST

As you travel across Europe, the pieces begin to fall into place.

Old contacts, forgotten names, and hidden documents reveal that your grandfather was involved in something far greater than you ever imagined.

The road will take you farther and farther from where you started.

And the farther you go, the harder the truth will be to ignore.

KEY FEATURES

  • Travel by road across different regions of Europe.

  • Explore towns, facilities, forests, mines, and other locations.

  • Repair, maintain, and refuel your vehicle throughout the journey.

  • Fight animals, infected enemies, creatures, and hostile humans.

  • Use both melee weapons and firearms.

  • Talk to characters and follow a mission-driven narrative.

  • Investigate locations and uncover documents, clues, and secrets.

  • Survive unexpected situations as you continue your journey.
